name: Firefly (Easy)
description: A curious scout with a slow scanning turret and no bullet avoidance.

name: Bloodhound (Medium)
description: Hunts the nearest opponent and sidesteps immediate bullets.

name: Sidewinder (Hard)
description: A mobile duelist that checks escape cells, muzzle threats, and firing lanes.

name: Prism (Expert)
description: Scores every action, avoids converging fire, and changes firing lanes.

name: Checkmate (Overkill)
description: Plans escape routes, pursues close firing positions, and suppresses escape lanes.
